name: cvc_auction_console
query: create table if not exists public.auction_team_state (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),draft_id uuid not null references public.draft(id) on delete cascade,franchise_id uuid not null references public.franchise(id) on delete cascade,starting_budget integer not null check (starting_budget between 0 and 115),spent_budget integer not null default 0 check (spent_budget >= 0),roster_count integer not null default 0 check (roster_count between 0 and 22),updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),unique (draft_id, franchise_id),check (spent_budget <= starting_budget)); create table if not exists public.auction_nomination (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),draft_id uuid not null references public.draft(id) on delete cascade,player_id uuid not null references public.player(id) on delete restrict,nominating_franchise_id uuid not null references public.franchise(id) on delete restrict,high_franchise_id uuid references public.franchise(id) on delete restrict,high_bid integer check (high_bid is null or high_bid >= 1),status text not null default 'active' check (status in ('active', 'awarded', 'passed', 'corrected')),awarded_at timestamptz,correction_reason text,created_at timestamptz not null default now(),updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); create unique index if not exists auction_active_nomination_idx on public.auction_nomination (draft_id) where status = 'active'; create unique index if not exists auction_player_once_idx on public.auction_nomination (draft_id, player_id) where status in ('active', 'awarded'); create index if not exists auction_team_state_draft_idx on public.auction_team_state (draft_id, franchise_id); create index if not exists auction_nomination_draft_idx on public.auction_nomination (draft_id, created_at desc); alter table public.auction_team_state enable row level security; alter table public.auction_nomination enable row level security; revoke all on table public.auction_team_state, public.auction_nomination from anon, authenticated; grant select, insert,update,delete on table public.auction_team_state, public.auction_nomination to service_role;
